scenarios.name: invalid input
scenarios.oracle: negative kstrtouint errno returned; exactly one failure printk; no mutex, bus, state, or queue call

scenarios.name: zero
scenarios.oracle: clear state flag, one masked bit clear, unlock before queue_work_on(0x20,...), return count

scenarios.name: valid positive below limit
scenarios.oracle: flag=1, save parsed value, set bit 0x20 in register 0x2d, unlock before work queue, return count

scenarios.name: equal-to-limit positive
scenarios.oracle: clear flag, log parsed value, no i2c_w_bits call, unlock and queue work, return count

scenarios.name: greater-than-limit positive
scenarios.oracle: same out-of-range path: clear flag, log value, skip bus update, queue work
